findings.title: @grafana/faro-web-tracing and @grafana/faro-core vulnerable to OTel unbounded memory (GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf)
findings.detail: @grafana/faro-web-sdk ^2.4.0 and @grafana/faro-web-tracing ^2.4.0 pull in @opentelemetry/core < 2.8.0, which has a moderate vulnerability (CVSS 5.3, CWE-770) allowing unbounded memory allocation via W3C Baggage header propagation. 13 packages are affected. All vulnerabilities are fixed in @grafana/faro-web-sdk >= 2.8.2 and @grafana/faro-web-tracing >= 2.8.2. The package.json range ^2.4.0 already covers 2.8.2; only package-lock.json needs to be refreshed.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `npm update @grafana/faro-web-sdk @grafana/faro-web-tracing` to pin to 2.8.2 in package-lock.json

findings.title: React 18 → 19 major version available
findings.detail: react and react-dom are at ^18.3.1 (latest compatible: 18.3.1). Latest published version is 19.2.7. React 19 is a major release with breaking changes (new JSX transform, concurrent features, hooks changes). package.json must be updated to ^19 and the React 19 migration guide should be followed before upgrading.
findings.suggested_fix: After reviewing https://react.dev/blog/2024/12/05/react-19 migration guide, run: npm install react@19 react-dom@19 @types/react@19 @types/react-dom@19

findings.title: All 5 recent CI runs on main have conclusion 'skipped'
findings.detail: The last 5 GitHub Actions runs on the main branch (2026-06-19 through 2026-06-26) all concluded with 'skipped'. This typically means all jobs in the workflow had conditions that evaluated to false. No actual test failures were detected, but CI is not providing coverage.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect the GitHub Actions workflow to ensure job conditions are correctly set for main branch pushes
